    INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant

     AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id
     AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id
     AND self_participant.presence_status = 1

           current_group.group_jid AS groupJid,
           COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.subject), '')),
                    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.display_name), ''))) AS groupName,
           MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(legacy_preview.owner_phone), '')) AS ownerPhone,
           MAX(CASE WHEN current_profile.wa_created_at IS NULL THEN NULL
                    ELSE FLOOR(current_profile.wa_created_at / 1000) END) AS groupCreatedAt,
           COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.checked_member_count),
                    MAX(current_profile.member_count)) AS memberSize,
           MAX(current_profile.announce_only) AS announceOnly,
           MAX(current_group.avatar_url) AS avatarUrl,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.metadata_observed_at), 0),
                    COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.last_checked_at), 0),
                    COALESCE(MAX(binding.last_observed_at), 0)) AS lastSyncedAt,
           MAX(current_profile.health_status) AS healthStatus,
           MAX(current_profile.banned) AS banned,
           MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.last_error_code), '')) AS healthError,
           MAX(CASE WHEN current_group.group_classification = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS historical,
           MAX(CASE WHEN jr.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS selfCollected,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
             WHEN self_participant.role IN (2, 3)
               OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')
                  = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')
             THEN a.id
           END) AS adminRelationCount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
             WHEN  
     
    (s.account_state = ?
      OR (s.login_state = 1 AND s.account_state IN
         (  ? , ? , ? ) ))
   
              AND (self_participant.role IN (2, 3)
                OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')
                   = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', ''))
             THEN a.id
           END) AS eligibleAccountCount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
             WHEN  
     
    (s.account_state = ?
      OR (s.login_state = 1 AND s.account_state IN
         (  ? , ? , ? ) ))
    AND s.login_state = 1
              AND (self_participant.role IN (2, 3)
                OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')
                   = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', ''))
             THEN a.id
           END) AS onlineAccountCount,
           MAX(jr.join_task_id) AS sourceJoinTaskId,
           MAX(jr.join_task_name) AS sourceJoinTaskName,
           MAX(jr.joined_at) AS sourceJoinedAt,
           MAX(jr.promoted_at) AS sourcePromotedAt,
           MAX(o.occupancy_type) AS occupancyType,
           MAX(o.reservation_token) AS reservationToken,
           MAX(o.task_id) AS occupiedTaskId,
           MAX(o.task_name_snapshot) AS occupiedTaskName,
           MAX(o.created_by) AS occupiedBy,
           MAX(o.last_validated_at) AS lastValidatedAt,
           MAX(o.last_validation_reason) AS lastValidationReason
    FROM wa_account_group_binding binding
    INNER JOIN wa_group current_group
      ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND current_group.id = binding.group_id
     AND current_group.deleted_at IS NULL
    INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant
      ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id
     AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id
     AND self_participant.presence_status = 1
    INNER JOIN account a
      ON a.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND a.id = binding.account_id
     AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN account_state s
      ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
     AND s.account_id = a.id
    INNER JOIN group_link handle
      ON handle.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND handle.group_id = binding.group_id
     AND handle.deleted_at IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN group_link_preview legacy_preview
      ON legacy_preview.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id
     AND legacy_preview.creator_phone_source <> 1
     AND legacy_preview.group_link_id = handle.id
    LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile
      ON current_profile.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND current_profile.group_id = binding.group_id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT ranked.tenant_id,
             ranked.group_jid,
             ranked.join_task_id,
             ranked.join_task_name,
             ranked.joined_at,
             ranked.promoted_at,
             ranked.id
      FROM (
        SELECT r.tenant_id,
               r.group_jid,
               r.join_task_id,
               t.name AS join_task_name,
               r.joined_at,
               r.promoted_at,
               r.id,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                 PARTITION BY r.tenant_id, r.group_jid
                 ORDER BY COALESCE(r.promoted_at, r.joined_at), r.id
               ) AS source_rank
        FROM join_task_result r
        INNER JOIN join_task t
          ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
         AND t.id = r.join_task_id
         AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE r.tenant_id = ?
          AND r.status = 'SUCCESS'
          AND r.is_admin = 1
      ) ranked
      WHERE ranked.source_rank = 1
    ) jr
      ON jr.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND jr.group_jid = current_group.group_jid
    LEFT JOIN pull_task_group_marketing_group_occupancy o
      ON o.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND o.group_jid = current_group.group_jid
     AND o.released_at IS NULL
    WHERE binding.tenant_id = ?
      AND (current_group.group_classification = 1 OR jr.id IS NOT NULL)
     
    GROUP BY current_group.group_jid
   ) candidate
    WHERE  
    1 = 1
     
      AND candidate.adminRelationCount > 0

           MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(legacy_preview.owner_phone), '')) AS ownerPhone,
           MAX(CASE WHEN current_profile.wa_created_at IS NULL THEN NULL
                    ELSE FLOOR(current_profile.wa_created_at / 1000) END) AS groupCreatedAt,
           COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.checked_member_count),
                    MAX(current_profile.member_count)) AS memberSize,
           MAX(current_profile.announce_only) AS announceOnly,
           MAX(current_group.avatar_url) AS avatarUrl,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.metadata_observed_at), 0),
                    COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.last_checked_at), 0),
                    COALESCE(MAX(binding.last_observed_at), 0)) AS lastSyncedAt,
           MAX(current_profile.health_status) AS healthStatus,
           MAX(current_profile.banned) AS banned,
           MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.last_error_code), '')) AS healthError,
           MAX(CASE WHEN current_group.group_classification = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS historical,
           MAX(CASE WHEN jr.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS selfCollected,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
             WHEN self_participant.role IN (2, 3)
               OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')
                  = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')
             THEN a.id
           END) AS adminRelationCount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
             WHEN  
     
    (s.account_state = ?
      OR (s.login_state = 1 AND s.account_state IN
         (  ? , ? , ? ) ))
   
              AND (self_participant.role IN (2, 3)
                OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')
                   = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', ''))
             THEN a.id
           END) AS eligibleAccountCount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
             WHEN  
     
    (s.account_state = ?
      OR (s.login_state = 1 AND s.account_state IN
         (  ? , ? , ? ) ))
    AND s.login_state = 1
              AND (self_participant.role IN (2, 3)
                OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')
                   = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', ''))
             THEN a.id
           END) AS onlineAccountCount,
           MAX(jr.join_task_id) AS sourceJoinTaskId,
           MAX(jr.join_task_name) AS sourceJoinTaskName,
           MAX(jr.joined_at) AS sourceJoinedAt,
           MAX(jr.promoted_at) AS sourcePromotedAt,
           MAX(o.occupancy_type) AS occupancyType,
           MAX(o.reservation_token) AS reservationToken,
           MAX(o.task_id) AS occupiedTaskId,
           MAX(o.task_name_snapshot) AS occupiedTaskName,
           MAX(o.created_by) AS occupiedBy,
           MAX(o.last_validated_at) AS lastValidatedAt,
           MAX(o.last_validation_reason) AS lastValidationReason
    FROM wa_account_group_binding binding
    INNER JOIN wa_group current_group
      ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND current_group.id = binding.group_id
     AND current_group.deleted_at IS NULL
    INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant
      ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id
     AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id
     AND self_participant.presence_status = 1
    INNER JOIN account a
      ON a.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND a.id = binding.account_id
     AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN account_state s
      ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
     AND s.account_id = a.id
    INNER JOIN group_link handle
      ON handle.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND handle.group_id = binding.group_id
     AND handle.deleted_at IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN group_link_preview legacy_preview
      ON legacy_preview.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id
     AND legacy_preview.creator_phone_source <> 1
     AND legacy_preview.group_link_id = handle.id
    LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile
      ON current_profile.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND current_profile.group_id = binding.group_id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT ranked.tenant_id,
             ranked.group_jid,
             ranked.join_task_id,
             ranked.join_task_name,
             ranked.joined_at,
             ranked.promoted_at,
             ranked.id
      FROM (
        SELECT r.tenant_id,
               r.group_jid,
               r.join_task_id,
               t.name AS join_task_name,
               r.joined_at,
               r.promoted_at,
               r.id,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                 PARTITION BY r.tenant_id, r.group_jid
                 ORDER BY COALESCE(r.promoted_at, r.joined_at), r.id
               ) AS source_rank
        FROM join_task_result r
        INNER JOIN join_task t
          ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
         AND t.id = r.join_task_id
         AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE r.tenant_id = ?
          AND r.status = 'SUCCESS'
          AND r.is_admin = 1
      ) ranked
      WHERE ranked.source_rank = 1
    ) jr
      ON jr.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND jr.group_jid = current_group.group_jid
    LEFT JOIN pull_task_group_marketing_group_occupancy o
      ON o.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id
     AND o.group_jid = current_group.group_jid
     AND o.released_at IS NULL
    WHERE binding.tenant_id = ?
      AND (current_group.group_classification = 1 OR jr.id IS NOT NULL)
     
    GROUP BY current_group.group_jid
   ) candidate
    WHERE  
    1 = 1
     
      AND candidate.adminRelationCount > 0 [42122-224]
